primary_scope: Original length-adjuster FIFO controller, original child core/data FIFO/header FIFO, no RTL behavior changes
selection_policy: Chosen before any new B/C generation; prefer direct core without RAM; if no certified nontrivial relevant group, retain rejection and do not invent redundant RTL. A separate version would be needed for another scope.
semantic_gate: At least one nontrivial egg-derived group with source-distinct guards, independent two-state proof, full event/activation context and raw-counter mapping; unsupported points explicit

qualification_formal.interpretation: Infrastructure/public-interface local checks only; not a GPT scoring oracle or whole functional correctness proof

stop_policy: No retries or budget increase within this version. Retain failures/timeouts. New live registration and Claude checker review remain separate gates.
revision_reason: Direct core violated status stall stability under legal inputs; counterexample physically reproduced by both simulators. Reject that scope. Qualify the original upstream FIFO wrapper with unchanged independent backpressure contract; no DUT patch or weakened assertion.
